title: Documentation placeholder stored encoded as a config value
summary: A config value decodes to the provider's documented placeholder assignment.
rationale: Decoder success alone does not make a secret: the decoded text is the documented placeholder.

expectation.rationale: Project policy of this example: decoding to a documented placeholder is not a credential.

notes: Worked example for the representation guide (ADR 0016). Synthetic; the policy stated here is an example, not a claim about any product.
